usage.rule: Use red as a focal signal, not as a full-page fill; keep original horizontal logo on light panel until approved reverse logo is available.

typography.numbers: Use tabular figures; choose one numeral convention per asset and do not mix styles on a single card.

logo.note: Do not squeeze the complete horizontal wordmark into a square avatar. Obtain vector original when possible.

content.initial_cadence: 1-2 posts per day; live coverage only for one selected match

editorial_rules: No statistic without source, timestamp, metric definition and sample window.
LLM writes narrative only; all numbers come from provider data or deterministic code.
Never mix xG values from different providers in one comparison unless definitions are reconciled.
No public release until data and asset rights are cleared.
